dedupe_keys.name: sen4cap sentinels for common agricultural policy processing system

description: Sen4CAP is a processing system that turns Copernicus Sentinel satellite imagery into parcel-level information for the EU Common Agricultural Policy, such as crop type, grassland mowing and other agricultural practices, so that national paying agencies can check farmers' declarations for compliance with subsidy schemes using a traffic light approach. It was developed in an ESA project by a consortium of five companies and institutions, working with paying agencies in six pilot countries (Czech Republic, Italy, Lithuania, Netherlands, Romania and the Spanish region of Castilla y Leon) under a steering committee of DG AGRI, the Joint Research Centre and DG GROW. Coverage is European Union farmland. Version 4.0 of the system, released in April 2024, is available free as a package downloaded after filling in a form, and since June 2026 its processors are also offered as services through the APEx and NoR platforms; products come in WGS84 and national projections in open formats. Caveats: the pages read do not state a software licence, and results depend on in-situ reference data and cloud-free imagery. For simulation it prepares parcel-level crop and practice maps that feed agricultural exposure, drought and adaptation models. It is related to the harmonised IACS inventory record in this catalogue, the declared parcel data it checks.
